comment: I had to read 3 books for this class (all of which I did not read) and do daily discussion posts on them. At first, he was an extremely tough grader and I was scared for my GPA (and life) however, he loosened up at the end. I got a great grade on my final research proposal (A+), however, this class was extremely boring. I hate space and astronauts!

Dr. Essid's class was the best English class I have taken. Extremely thought-provoking, he offers great insight, and the content he chooses is very enjoyable. He's a VERY tough grader (-10 points for putting the wrong character name), but we only had 2 papers. You can also only miss one class before points are deducted from final grade. Overalleasy

I can see how Dr. Essid would be a tough professor for his normal classes. However, since 383 is a requirement for a writing consultant job, he really cares about his students doing well. Essid had us redo assignments until we got a 100% so my grade in his class was the least of my worries. He is also a funny guy and you can tell he cares a lot.

Dr. Essid goes out of his way to brutally offend students. He will call you out in front of everyone if you make any sort of minor mistake, and makes you feel horrible and incompetent. If possible, avoid any of his classes, for your own mental health and well being. He truly only cares about himself.

I read a story once about a man who would leave out 5 single dollar bills on the table as the tip for his waiter. Every time the waiter did something the man did not like he would quietly take a dollar away. That is what Essid's class is in an essence.
Joe Essid is the worth teacher that has ever walked this planet. He is boring in class and actively seeks to ruin students lives. Never take his classes

I took two classes with Dr. Essid this past semester and ENGL 383 was a significantly different experience. I felt that the expectations and guidelines for our commentary was very confusing, but once we all figured it out for ourselves, the class was pretty easy. The midterm felt somewhat pointless and the final was essentially the same assignment.

Dr. Essid is an excellent professor who genuinely cares about the success of his students. He has unusual beliefs, but he is tolerant and interested in the opinions of others and takes all viewpoints seriously. He engages with his students in order to make them not only better writers, but better students overall.

Best professor ever. Caring, funny, and extremely intelligent. Will challenge you to do your best work and think outside the box. Does not put up with laziness. If you work hard, however, he rewards you. I took his Writing Center training class - he does grade that a bit easier than his other classes, but he is fair and always available to help.

Dr. Essid is an awesome professor. He is very engaging and really helpful. You do a lot of writing and sometimes he grades tough, but you will never  get a grade and not know why you got it. The class was really helpful too. The final project is very lengthy and hard.

My favorite professor so far!  He balanced our reading assignments with movies.  Very interested in the wellbeing of each student.  Tough but fair grader, he can tell if you wrote a paper the night before!  He emphasized the value of experiential learning; my favorite assignment was the road trip paper.  My idea of a true liberal arts-style eacher!
He's a hard grader and you'll do a lot of writing. However, he is extremely helpful and clear.Be prepared to do a lengthy final project and don't expect to get an easy A.
I had him for teaching writing course. Very helpful and engaged. He's what all UR profs should be. He can connect with students. I had him 10 years ago.

I had the chance to communicate with him in Spanish. Really nice guy, who is not only academically engaged, but also keenly intersted in the welfare of int students. I was glad to hear that he is interested in visiting Bulgaria. Even funnier, he thought I was a grad student, what a great compliment. I really loved the Spanish talks.

A great professor.  He always makes sure that everyone knows the details of each assignment.  He is really interesting and very passionate about writing.  He is a very tough grader, but at least he tells you what you did wrong and he prefers to meet with you about each paper.
Great class.  He's a great instructor, I would recommend him for any class.  Very liberal politically and loves to blab about anything.
Dr. Essid is a fun professor and teaches interesting classes. His book selection for courses is good too.
